items.title: Diamond Mesh Butterfly DXF Panel for Layered Silhouette Screens

items.title: Interlocking Wave Cross DXF Lattice for Modern Privacy Screens
items.description: Curved wave-like links interlock into a dense repeating cross grid, giving a smooth, puzzle-like texture with no sharp corners. The soft, continuous pattern suits modern privacy screens, cabinet fronts, and gate infill panels.

items.title: Chain Link Border Floral Medallion DXF Slat Panel
items.description: This design is free to cut and pairs a repeating chain-link border with small tribal-style corner accents around wide horizontal slats and a central dotted floral wreath. The chain motif gives the border a mechanical, almost industrial rhythm that contrasts nicely with the softer floral center.
